chosen_decision.reason: Historical exact causal prefix state is unavailable, while one nested train-only recipe can own every exactness dimension for all compared families without weakening the exact-incumbent standard.
chosen_decision.why_not_central_revision: A wording revision cannot create missing prefix masks, component OOF, epoch selection, meta-refit, May-June OOF, or complete-pipeline seed state; it would relax the claim without producing a common causal comparison surface.

population and row keys.surrogate_owner: sealed reference OOF hashes plus a pre-score key-manifest receipt
population and row keys.dry_run_evidence: five cutoff surfaces each report 78156 rows and share one matched configuration
population and row keys.execution_requirement: Every family, seed, and cutoff must reproduce the same ordered station/layer/time/truth key digest before any score is computed.

outer folds.dry_run_evidence: three required fold names occur on the matched causal surrogate
outer folds.execution_requirement: No family-specific fold or validation-window change is allowed.

training cutoffs.dry_run_evidence: matched surface carries all five registered fractions
training cutoffs.execution_requirement: The cutoff timestamp receipt must be identical across families for every outer fold and fraction.

complete-pipeline seeds.dry_run_evidence: matched causal surface has three complete-pipeline seed columns
complete-pipeline seeds.execution_requirement: Every stochastic component and meta fit derives its child seed from the same complete-pipeline seed.

prefix mask semantics.dry_run_evidence: semantic contract only; implementation conformance remains required
prefix mask semantics.execution_requirement: Target temp/psal labels outside the eligible chronological prefix are jointly unavailable to every fit and selector.

component OOF availability.dry_run_evidence: semantic contract only; no current exact component OOF claim
component OOF availability.execution_requirement: Stack and gate may fit only on nested expanding-window component OOF predictions.

epoch and meta-refit semantics.dry_run_evidence: semantic contract only; no current exact refit claim
epoch and meta-refit semantics.execution_requirement: Epochs, stack weights, and gate coefficients must be selected inside each prefix without frozen exposed-block parameters.

postprocess opportunity and metric aggre.dry_run_evidence: matched comparison applies the same profile projection, RMSE aggregation, and day bootstrap
postprocess opportunity and metric aggre.execution_requirement: All families receive the identical fixed postprocess and metric implementation.

authoritative_nested_surrogate_recipe.claim: new authoritative train-only surrogate comparator; never the exact official incumbent

base_architecture.source: official inference component roles and immutable model-family hyperparameters pinned by the exact audit source hashes

chronological_prefix_contract.tie_rule: include every row at the selected cutoff timestamp
chronological_prefix_contract.population_rule: oldest timestamps through the selected cutoff inclusive
chronological_prefix_contract.mask_rule: all target labels later than the selected cutoff or inside validation/embargo are unavailable before every fit, epoch choice, stack fit, and gate fit

nested_component_oof_contract.construction: split prefix unique timestamps into four deterministic contiguous equal-count blocks using integer boundaries floor(j*N/4); for inner fold j=1..3 train on blocks strictly before validation block j and validate on block j after a seven-day embargo
nested_component_oof_contract.component_oof_population: concatenated validation predictions from the three expanding inner folds
nested_component_oof_contract.stack_fit: per target layer nonnegative least squares normalized to sum one; all-zero solution falls back to uniform contributor weights
nested_component_oof_contract.gate_fit: fixed public-state features only, trained on the same nested component OOF rows

epoch_and_meta_contract.deep_epoch_selection: for each component and complete-pipeline seed, choose the minimum-RMSE checkpoint inside each inner fold and use the middle of the three integer best epochs for the full-prefix refit

complete_pipeline_seed_contract.seed_averaging: arithmetic mean after identical per-seed postprocess

uncertainty.unit: KST calendar day sampled within outer fold with shared draws across families, cutoffs, and seeds

requirements_before_separate_training_au: prefix-mask API implements and unit-tests joint target temp/psal masking
nested component OOF generator writes ordered key/truth digests
epoch and meta-refit implementation is hash-pinned
three complete-pipeline seed fan-out is unit-tested
45-cell execution plan dry-runs without accessing labels outside each prefix
all family views declare one identical evaluation key digest
independent validator returns PASS on every exactness dimension
automatic_stop_conditions: any family differs in population, row order, outer fold, cutoff timestamp, seed set, postprocess, or metric
any exact-official-incumbent wording is emitted for the surrogate
any frozen exposed-block stack weight, gate coefficient, or epoch is reused
any official test/sample/submission value or Public score enters selection
any implementation or grid changes after the first score
